message:
docs(history): the recovery is verified, and RDP is on

The verifier checked cacede2 independently -- pulling the pair off the server
themselves, fetching all ten public URLs, re-deriving the required set from
source, and running remote60_verify_release on the bytes they fetched. 10/10,
required-set satisfied, backup pair intact at 1534B / mtime 15:42.

One thing that closed properly: the server reads the manifest per request and
re-verifies it with loadManifest before serving it, so "that file passes that
implementation" IS the check on the response body. The place where an
unauthenticated 401 used to stand in for evidence is gone.

They also withdrew the instruction to revert the backup guard: d110fe2 does not
contain it, and the comment quoted back at me was the one I had just written.
Worth keeping because of what it cost -- had the instruction been followed, this
recovery's rollback point would have been gone on the first retry. "Already
there" and "just added" are indistinguishable in a working tree. And the same
message was right about the other thing: uploading without naming in the manifest
would not have worked. One message can be wrong in one claim and right in the
next, so the unit to check is the claim, not the message.

qwinsta now shows rdp-tcp#0 shotan 1 Active. At the time of the four red suites
session 1 was Disc. Both are "no desktop attached at the console", which is the
reason the RDP rule exists -- so the candidate in #497 is stronger, but Disc and
an active RDP session are not the same state and this is still not a cause. No
tests were run: results produced under RDP are not evidence either way.

The three follow-ups stay separate and unfixed, now on the task list. The first
is worth naming: GNLinkUpdater.exe is in the manifest and therefore staged, but
it is not in payloadNames, so it is never moved into the install directory. The
updater cannot update itself.
